title: DefiHub
tagline: DeFiHub is a cross-chain liquidity router that automatically move asset
description:
DeFiHub is a Cross-Chain Liquidity Router that solves DeFi's fragmented liquidity problem. Using a Hub-and-Spoke architecture powered by LayerZero, it allows users to deposit USDC into a single central vault. The protocol then automatically routes this capital to the highest-yielding opportunities across connected chains like Optimism and Arbitrum.

Built with Next.js 16, Wagmi, and a custom Tailwind CSS design, the platform offers an institutional-grade dashboard for real-time tracking, deposits, and one-click withdrawals. By abstracting away complex bridging and gas management, DeFiHub provides a seamless, unified experience for maximizing cross-chain yields.
how_its_made:
DeFiHub is built on a cutting-edge tech stack designed for performance, scalability, and a premium user experience.

At the core, we utilize Next.js 16 with the App Router, leveraging Server Components for fast initial loads and optimized rendering. The entire application is written in TypeScript, ensuring strict type safety and reducing runtime errors, which is critical for handling financial data securely.

For the user interface, we made a deliberate choice to bypass heavy component libraries. Instead, we utilized Tailwind CSS v4 to craft a completely custom, high-density design system. This approach allowed us to implement 'glassmorphism' effects, responsive grids, and smooth transitions while keeping the production bundle size minimal and the aesthetic unique.
